Playwright is intentionally not a dependency of this toolkit. Existing repository or host Playwright installations remain independent.

The latest MCP SDK is pinned with an @hono/node-server 2.0.11 security override because the SDK's declared transitive range otherwise resolves Windows path-traversal and WebSocket-handshake advisories. The toolkit uses only the SDK stdio client and validates this override with npm audit and the live smoke.
